title: Contingency Placement Agreements — Proration of the Early-Termination Fee to the Unexpired Initial Term
content:
**Clause.** When a creditor client terminates an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements so that the termination takes effect before the end of the initial term, how much of the tier's early-termination fee is charged depends on how much of the initial term is unexpired:

(a) when the unexpired initial term is no more than half the length of the initial term and the tier's initial term is 24 months or more, the fee is charged pro rata to the unexpired whole months, a whole month being each complete 30 calendar days of the unexpired term counted down, so the fee is multiplied by those whole months and divided by the tier's initial term in months;

(b) when the unexpired initial term is no more than half the length of the initial term and the tier's initial term is under 24 months, the fee is charged pro rata to the unexpired calendar days, so the fee is multiplied by the unexpired days and divided by the length of the initial term in days;

(c) when more than half the initial term is unexpired, the fee is charged in full.

**Counting the days.** The unexpired initial term is counted in calendar days from the date the termination takes effect to the end of the initial term, and the length of the initial term in calendar days from the agreement's effective date to the end of the initial term. Each such count is the difference between the two dates in calendar days: the first date is not counted and the last date is counted. The prorated fee is carried unrounded into the charge, which is rounded to the cent.

## Condition table

| Unexpired days compared with half the initial term's length | Tier's initial term | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| no more than half | 24 months or more | fee multiplied by the unexpired whole months (complete 30-day spans), divided by the tier's initial term in months |
| no more than half | under 24 months | fee multiplied by the unexpired days, divided by the initial term's length in days |
| more than half | any | the fee in full |

## Worked cases (hypothetical inputs)

*Initial term of 24 months, fee 15000.00 USD, initial term length 730 days.*

- 300 unexpired days: 300 is no more than 365, half of 730. Complete 30-day spans in 300 days: 10. The fee multiplied by 10 and divided by 24 is 6250.00 USD.
- 365 unexpired days, exactly half: still no more than half. Complete 30-day spans in 365 days: 12, the last 5 days not making a whole month. The fee multiplied by 12 and divided by 24 is 7500.00 USD.
- 366 unexpired days: more than half, so the fee is charged in full, 15000.00 USD.

*Initial term of 12 months, fee 1500.00 USD, effective date 2025-06-01, initial term ending 2026-05-31: length 364 days.*

- 81 unexpired days: no more than 182, half of 364. The fee multiplied by 81 and divided by 364 is 333.7912 USD, which is 333.79 USD at the cent.
- 182 unexpired days, exactly half: 750.00 USD.
- 183 unexpired days: more than half, so 1500.00 USD.
